name: B10-0463/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Polarisation and increased repression in Serbia, one year after the Novi Sad tragedy
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the polarisation and increased repression in Serbia, one year after the Novi Sad tragedy
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is setting out its opinion and asking for action. It asks Serbia to stop police violence against peaceful protesters, release people held, and investigate the Novi Sad station roof collapse that killed 16 people. It asks the European Union to consider sanctions on those responsible, to hold back some funding until Serbia improves rule of law and media freedom, and to support early elections.

- It asks the EU to consider sanctions and hold back funds; Serbia's government and protesters are affected.
- It calls for a full investigation into the Novi Sad collapse and other rail projects.
- Next, Parliament plans to send a fact-finding mission to Serbia to assess the situation.
